title: Influence of metal doping on the coke formation of a novel hierarchical HZSM-5 zeolite catalyst in the conversion of 1-propanol to fuel blendstock
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3988-3999
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07707E, Paper

In this work, the effect of Ni doping on coke formation and the activity of a novel hierarchical HZSM-5 zeolite catalyst in the conversion of 1-propanol to fuel blends was investigated.
